name: プロジェクトのページへ移動するAirtableサブナビゲーション
prompt:
Second attempt. Recreate only the supplied Airtable Projects sub-navigation at 285x207 px. Keep the same vertical layout and source-aligned positions: group icon near x=10,y=10; group title 「プロジェクト」 starting near x=50,y=11; thin nested guide at x=19 from about y=42 downward; active row rectangle near x=35,y=42, width about227 and height37; then three remaining labels at x=50 with baselines around y=99, 137, and 175.

Use a small simple outlined 3x3 grid icon for the group, made of tiny square cells; do not draw a building, house, skyline, or large icon. Keep the group title compact and bold at about14 px. Use exactly these four links: selected 「概要」 in bold dark text; then regular muted-gray 「プロジェクトギャラリー」, 「プロジェクトタイムライン」, and 「プロジェクトダッシュボード」. Use compact 14 px Japanese system sans and keep every link on one line.

Use a flat pale peach background close to the reference (around #FBE8DC) with no gradient. The selected row is a slightly darker, low-saturation salmon tint (around #F5CDBB) with a small warm muted marker along the left guide. Keep the source's small rounded corners and subdued colors; avoid vivid orange, glow, shadows, or extra containers. No other labels, icons, badges, or content.
reviewNotes: Reviewed against the exact 285x207 Airtable project-subnavigation crop. The 3x3 grid icon, group title, nested rail, selected Overview row, and three remaining links are complete and correctly aligned. Pale peach and salmon selected colors are close to source; long Japanese labels fit on one line. Raw aspect ratio differs by less than 0.1% and was normalized to exact crop size.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
